in_hindi.name: सुखेन
in_hindi.meaning: सुख (संस्कृतिक) + एन (एक अधिक होना) = सुखी + एक (एक व्यक्ति) = सुखेन
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is more happy or one who is moving towards more happiness

in_tamil.name: சுக்கேன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is born out of happiness and is not departing from it

in_telugu.name: శుఖేన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the embodiment of happiness and is always in that state

in_marathi.name: Sukhen
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukhen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who brings happiness and joy

in_bengali.name: Sukhen
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Happy, Joyful
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sukhen একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who brings happiness and joy
